name: Verify Phase 3B Shadow Integration

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  phase3b-shadow-tests:
    name: Phase 3B shadow safety and integration tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Compile bot and shadow modules
        run: |
          python -m py_compile \
            bot.py \
            shadow_model_engine.py \
            shadow_learning_engine.py \
            shadow_runtime.py \
            test_shadow_learning.py \
            test_shadow_runtime.py \
            test_phase3b_wiring.py

      - name: Run Phase 3A and Phase 3B tests
        run: python -m unittest -v test_shadow_learning.py test_shadow_runtime.py test_phase3b_wiring.py
